titles sessions as <folder>/<bookmark-or-branch>, degrading to <folder> on trunk or an unnamed ref. gates teammate idle on `make validate`; exit 2 feeds stderr back and the teammate keeps working. Fires once per teammate turn-end. Supports no matchers, so the Makefile-has-validate check lives in the script

2.1.218 made context:fork skills background by default. Opted this one out because it rewrites history and pr-safety.md requires stopping to ask before touching a reviewed branch -- backgrounded, that checkpoint degrades to a parked needs-input request. monitoring-ci and validating-project stay backgrounded

FIXED A LIVE BUG: hooks/status.sh read .rate_limits[0].used_percentage but rate_limits is an object keyed by five_hour/seven_day, so the rl segment had never rendered. Rewrote as two rows, one jq pass. ctx now reports used rather than remaining so ctx and rl both mean consumed. Cost omitted to match DISABLE_COST_WARNINGS. Neither row is character-sliced -- both carry escapes and cutting mid-sequence corrupts the terminal

adopted.feature: statusLine payload: fast_mode, context_window_size, cost line churn, pr.url via OSC 8
adopted.note: PASS 3 (2026-07-29) added rate_limits.*.resets_at, a burn-rate pacing signal, an 8-cell context bar, ANSI threshold colours, and statusLine.refreshInterval=60. Pace = used% vs elapsed% of the window; green <=125, yellow <=175, red above, suppressed under 15% used, with absolute overrides at 75/90. A 'fast' word appears only past the warn band. Renders in ~50ms. PASS 2 note follows -- second pass after auditing all ~40 documented payload fields against the 12 in use. fast_mode matters because Opus 5 fast mode is $10/$50 per Mtok and the state drifts (2.1.219 fixed stale fast-mode on Remote Control). context_window_size disambiguates ctx% -- a fallbackModel hop to Haiku silently drops 1M to 200k, previously invisible. exceeds_200k_tokens folded into the size as a trailing '+' (long-context premium marker) instead of its own segment. Line churn uses the up/down arrow notation from rules/status-marks.md. PR label wrapped in OSC 8 with plain text inside per the linked-labels rule. Dropped the standalone 'think' segment: alwaysThinkingEnabled makes it near-constant
